type: Proposed comprehensive roadmap; preserves all earlier checkpoints and data
primary_question: Which linguistic changes do candidate NLP measures capture in controlled thought-disorder simulations, and can they distinguish those changes from benign style, length and reporting-policy differences across generators?

integrated_roles.team_type_severity_study: Main measurement corpus and candidate localization result
integrated_roles.persona_feature_audit: Source-to-behavior evidence and mechanism-specific confound controls, not discarded appendix-only work
integrated_roles.measurement_audit: Metric failure modes and nonclinical specificity evidence
integrated_roles.psyche_local_ports: Bounded implementation/operationalization evidence; not native framework ranking or established clinical improvement

proposed_primary_extension: Validate local-versus-global measurement with matched benign controls and unused cases; retain a negative result if the effect does not transfer

sequence.task: Link and harmonize existing team corpus, prompt conditions, model/rater metadata, feature outputs and reference-span provenance
sequence.output: Data lineage and existing-result reproduction with type-by-generator plots

sequence.task: Use existing persona findings as sentinel controls for length, disclosure and benign topic changes; never merge Qwen-only negatives with Claude/GPT-only positives as a clinical classifier
Audit the 41 percent localization claim's span origin, selection and chance baseline; compare fixed local and global methods on the same records
sequence.output: Localization effect, uncertainty, benign-control behavior and a reproducible null model

sequence.task: Freeze one candidate method and evaluate unused cases and independent generator conditions; preserve case-question blocks
sequence.output: Out-of-development confirmation or an interpretable negative conclusion

sequence.task: Only if a specific failure and an evaluable endpoint remain, test one source-grounded repair on unused conditions
sequence.output: One repair comparison or a documented decision not to expand

sequence.task: Add targeted clinical consultation when available; without it, finalize a synthetic-language measurement study rather than a clinically validated tool
sequence.output: Bounded manuscript claim, corpus/code and 2 to 3 page Korean team report

expert_gate_policy: Expert access is necessary for claims requiring clinical validity, not a prerequisite for every synthetic-data measurement or independent-model replication analysis
resource_policy: Existing raw outputs first. Local code handles parsing, features, statistics and reports. Qwen is not automatically the main generator or a clinical judge. No paid API, new model, installs, remote jobs or bulk generation authorized by this roadmap.
new_generation_policy: Do not issue a new generation budget until the missing condition/span tables are linked and a specific remaining comparison is identified. One bounded confirmation batch, not an open-ended search for favorable results.
stop_rules: A metric consistently reacts to benign controls: report insufficient specificity; do not call it a thought-disorder detector
Localization does not transfer: retain the exploratory result and report non-replication; no rolling new-metric search on the same holdout
No experts: narrow the claim to synthetic measurement, do not fabricate ratings or halt all useful analysis
A required raw artifact is missing: identify that dependency while finishing analyses supported by available data
not_actions_taken: No new thread or external-model job created
